plans.idea: Classic banner read left to right: bottle anchors the left, a brand stack (logo over a large headline and subline) fills the middle, and the CTA sits on the right at the text's vertical center.
Bottle in the center, with brand and message on the left and the action on the right, so the eye goes logo, headline, product, Shop Now.
One left-aligned column of logo, headline with subline, and CTA on a shared left edge, balanced by a large bottle on the right, like the original's text-plus-product pairing turned sideways.
